from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, ForeignKey, Date, Float
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()


class Aluno(Base):
    __tablename__ = "aluno"

    id_aluno = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    nome_completo = Column(String(80), nullable=False)
    email = Column(String(120), unique=True)


class Curso(Base):
    __tablename__ = "curso"

    id_curso = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    titulo = Column(Text, nullable=False)


class Matricula(Base):
    __tablename__ = "matricula"

    aluno_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("aluno.id_aluno"), nullable=False)
    curso_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("curso.id_curso"), nullable=False)
    data_matricula = Column(Date)
    nota = Column(Float)
    # chave composta: aluno_id, curso_id (use PrimaryKeyConstraint em __table_args__)

    aluno = relationship("Aluno")
    curso = relationship("Curso")


class Tutor(Base):

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    aluno = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("aluno.id_aluno"))
    mentor_principal = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("aluno.id_aluno"))
